title: Minimalist chrome — the controls you asked to soften

steps.path: The strip along the top of the window
steps.headline: The top controls, with the odd halo gone and glass behind them
steps.changed: The glow around each control was tinted with the theme's border colour, which on a dark theme is LIGHTER than the page — so every control wore a grey halo. The shadow is now the app's own neutral shadow, and each control frosts what is behind it instead of sitting on it flatly.
steps.measured: shadow is now neutral black at 0.16 on Midnight — it was the theme's grey edge colour; blur(22px) on a wallpaper theme, up from none
steps.notice: On Midnight the controls stop glowing. On Meadow Mist you can see the wallpaper through them, softly blurred.
steps.risk: The controls are a little more see-through than before, so a very busy wallpaper makes their small labels slightly harder to read.

steps.path: The message box and the strip under it
steps.headline: The message box and chips, frosted the same way
steps.changed: The message field, the quick chips and every status chip now frost the wallpaper behind them and carry the neutral shadow instead of the grey halo.
steps.measured: fill at 58% of the theme's own inset colour, blur(22px) — the same values the app's other glass panels already use
steps.notice: They read as part of the picture rather than as boxes laid on top of it.
steps.risk: Same controls, same places. Nothing moved.

steps.path: The edges of every lifted control
steps.headline: How should a lifted control end at its edge?
steps.notice: Both of these are the softened version — the halo is gone and the glass is on in each. The only difference is whether the control draws a line around itself.
steps.risk: With no line at all, a control sitting on a busy part of a wallpaper has only its shadow to say where it ends.

variants.label: A thin edge
variants.summary: The control keeps the one-pixel edge it has today, in the theme's own border colour. It reads as a definite thing with a definite edge.
variants.measured: 1 px edge, shadow alpha 0.24 (measured on Meadow Mist)

variants.label: No edge, just depth
variants.summary: The edge is gone entirely. The control is carried by its fill and a deeper shadow, so there is no drawn line anywhere — this is the "fades into the background" reading.
variants.measured: border transparent, shadow alpha 0.42 (measured on Meadow Mist)
variants.risk: It is the softer of the two, and on a light wallpaper the pale controls lose the crisp line that separates them from the page.
